subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit window clarification
messages:
From: Jill Tan <security@acme-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Reyes <devops@greenline.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit window clarification

Hi Hannah,

We're kicking off procurement for a new contract and need your SOC 2 Type II materials for our security intake. Specifically: 1) a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), 2) a bridge letter if the report does not fully cover our required audit window, and 3) a short list of what evidence/attachments you can share (control snapshots, log samples, retention policies).

Our preferred audit window is Jul 1, 2026 — Jun 30, 2027. Can you confirm whether your latest Type II covers that window or advise what bridge letter wording you can provide?

Deadline for our procurement packet: 2027-07-08.

Transfer options we can accept: S3 presigned link, secure ShareFile link, or a secure portal. We can also accept redacted artifacts if needed. Let us know lead time to produce the package and any standard templates you use.

Thanks,
Jill Tan
Sr. Security Manager — Acme Analytics
security@acme-analytics.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jill Tan <security@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit window clarification

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: we can share our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter that covers the gap between the report period and your requested window. Below is what we typically include and a couple of short reply templates you can copy into procurement.

What we'll share by default:
- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20260601-20270601.pdf (Type II report; control testing period 2026-06-01 to 2027-06-01)
- Bridge letter (PDF/DOCX) stating coverage assumptions and any residual risk areas — we use a standard template, attached here as Bridge_Letter_template.docx
- Evidence manifest (example): a manifest CSV listing artifact name, control mapped, redaction guidance, and transfer path.

Typical transfer options and notes:
- Presigned S3 (48–72 hour expiry) — preferred for bulk artifacts.
- ShareFile / Box secure link — fine for single reports and a few artifacts.
- Encrypted zip via secure portal (for very large bundles).

Redaction guidance: we redact account numbers and personal emails on request; we do not redact control IDs or system names. If you need additional redaction, note it up front and allow 1–2 business days.

Sample one-line templates for your packet (feel free to paste):
- "Redwood provided their SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter confirming coverage; artifacts will be delivered via presigned S3 link."
- "Vendor will deliver an evidence manifest and redacted samples (log snippets, retention policies) on or before 2027-07-06."

I've attached: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20260601-20270601.pdf and Bridge_Letter_template.docx for your review. If the exact period you need is Jul 1, 2026 — Jun 30, 2027, our bridge letter will explicitly state testing period endpoints and any interim controls changes.

If that works, I'll coordinate secure transfer with Kimberly and include the evidence manifest template so you can see the expected artifacts.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20260601-20270601.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Bridge_Letter_template.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit window clarification

Looping in transfer and artifact details so we can respond with a single package. Options we can prepare quickly: presigned S3 bundle (manifest + PDFs + log snippets), ShareFile folder for smaller sets, or encrypted container.

Suggested deliverable manifest (we'll attach as evidence_manifest_template.csv):
- Document name	Control mapping	Format	Redaction required	Presigned path
- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20260601-20270601.pdf	CC3	PDF	No	[link]
- Bridge_Letter_20270625.pdf	N/A	PDF	No	[link]
- retention_policy_snapshot_202705.pdf	CC6	PDF	Mask emails	[link]
- log_sample_auth_20270601.txt	CC7	txt	Mask IPs	[link]

Timing: If we get confirmation today we can generate a presigned S3 bundle and manifest within 24 hours. If Acme requires specific redactions, add one business day.

A few notes on bridge wording: we avoid language that implies retrospective testing beyond the report's attestation period. Our template states the report covers controls tested through 2027-06-01 and that the bridge letter addresses continuity of controls through 2027-06-30, where applicable.

Attaching: evidence_manifest_template.csv

Kimberly
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_manifest_template.csv (csv)
